subject: nlg-slice-share = 16
claim: a prefill slice bounded by a sixteenth of the device budget keeps the machine working while the prompt is walked
test: walk one packet at shares 8, 16, 32 and 64, recording resident bytes and wall time for each; the ground is the largest share whose resident stays inside the working set without the machine swapping

subject: the keeper fires at 03:30
claim: 03:30 is an hour when the walk does not contend with the machine's other work
test: a week of .hearth/rent-walk.log wall times beside the host's load at that hour; an hour whose walks run slower than a hand-started walk is the wrong hour

subject: the folded seed reading
claim: folding five empty seed blocks into one line removes a structure that competes with the axis section and may help a small voice
test: several walks per arm at one allowance, folded and unfolded, comparing axes named and used share; the spread witnessed on 2026-09-22 was 233, 1322 and 624 tokens on identical input, so two walks cannot tell the arms apart

subject: fgs-min-answer-bytes = 1200
claim: an answer under 1,200 bytes is thin enough to be worth naming
test: the byte counts of answers that met the structural floor beside those that did not; the threshold belongs where the two populations part

subject: the wedge at 4,200 prompt IDs
claim: the 71.7 GB that stopped the adapter lane is the attention tape: layers x t x heads x (pos+t), quadratic in the slice
witness: the body's own nlg-forward-bytes gives 70.0 GB for 28 layers, d 3072, 24 heads, 8 kv x 128, intermediate 8192 at t 4,200; 71.7 GB was measured resident, and bounding the slice brought the same packet to 6.3 GB

subject: the native voice invents nothing
claim: every number the native lane has spoken was one the packet gave it
witness: four measured answers with their packets retained: 4/4, 12/12, 9/9 and 16/16 numbers grounded, 100% in every case, in receipts/voice-quality-ledger.jsonl

subject: citation is not a reproduction problem
claim: the voice does not cite because it never reaches for a citation, not because a path is too long to copy
witness: the walk of 2026-09-22 offered eight four-character keys: 0 used, 0 unknown, and not one occurrence of a bracket key or a receipts path in the raw answer

subject: who coordinated a movement
claim: a movement can say whether a rented mind was in it, read from the host's own process table rather than declared
witness: a session-started movement read coordinated_by session, coordinator /bin/zsh, rented_mind 1; the field is written to receipts/crossings-ledger.jsonl per movement

subject: tokens per turn
claim: the body can read what each turn of a conversation cost the rented mind, from the transcript alone, counting a message once per id and opening a turn only at a person's own words
witness: this session on 2026-09-22 read as 14 turns, 2,338,202 uncached and 149,770,934 with cache reads; counting host reminders and task notices as askings had inflated it to 20 turns before that was corrected

subject: coordinating rent per movement
claim: a movement can carry what the rented mind spent on the turn it belongs to, so the goal's second ledger column is a row rather than a number typed afterwards
witness: a session-started movement on 2026-09-22 wrote coordinated_by session, rented_mind 1, coordinating_rent 27872; a walk whose parent is launchd carries rented_mind 0 and coordinating_rent 0 by observation of that parent
